name: Sleepless in Selangor 2025

venue.name: The Box Event Space
venue.address: 3-1, Jalan 20/13, Taman Paramount, 46300 Petaling Jaya, Selangor

information: # Note: This is a midnight competition. Welcome to Sleepless in Selangor 2025! This will be a **midnight** competition, please look through the schedule before registering. [![Malaysia Cube Association(MYCSA)](https://imgur.com/ZUv6wZJ.jpg)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/SleeplessinSelangor2025) All competitors are advised to review the information provided in the ["**Updates & Announcements**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SleeplessinSelangor2025#52356-updates-announcements). New competitors, in particular, should carefully read the ["**New Competitors**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SleeplessinSelangor2025#52357-new-competitors) for essential details before registering. ​ Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information.
